description: COPILOT_HOME replaces ~/.copilot, so process logs are written to $COPILOT_HOME/logs/process-<timestamp>-<pid>.log.
note: Path-only characterization: the pinned v1.0.101 changelog documents COPILOT_HOME replacing ~/.copilot, but Telltale does not read it. As in home-process-log, static inspection of the earlier v1.0.96 runtime (SHA256 e6c9513e7dcff38e424c247a8ae7b5b8a283e93973b77eb31fba9ef769f1c95b) does not qualify the default-level accumulated-output format for either version. The copied Telltale fixture is not upstream output. Relocated discovery and supported promotion require authoritative format/default-level evidence and successful discovery plus acquisition; do not infer events.jsonl or session-store.db schemas.
